entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Please state the reason for your call.
I want to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago, and it's just not working out for me. I want my money back.
Okay, I understand. I can definitely help you with a return. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

It's [customer email address]. This is ridiculous. I just want to return the damn smart watch. It's not tracking my sleep properly, and the heart rate sensor is all over the place. It was a VeloBand Pulse.

Thank you. I've located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on [date of purchase]. Our standard return policy is 90 days. No problem at all. We can process the return for you. To confirm, are you returning the entire VeloBand Pulse kit, including all original packaging and accessories?
Yes, everything's here. All the boxes, the charger, the stupid little booklets nobody reads... everything. I just want to be done with this. Your website said I could return it!

I apologize for any inconvenience, and I appreciate your patience. Let's proceed with the return. According to our return policy, you have plenty of time for a return. Although we do have specific return policies based on products. For this VeloBand Pulse, You have up to 90 days. I will send you a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Just pack everything up securely, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. It should reflect in your account within 7-10 business days. If you have any issues, please let me know.
Finally! That's all I wanted. How long before I get the label?
You should receive the label within the next hour. Please check your spam folder just in case it ends up there. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks. I appreciate you just getting it done, unlike that automated system. It sounds like I should just avoid any VeloBand Pulse products in the future.
You're welcome! We appreciate your business, and we hope you'll continue to shop with VeloFit. I am sorry the VeloBand Pulse didn't meet your needs. Have a great day!
